min-inline-size.comment: A raw dimension, following dropdown-menu.min-inline-size. A listbox MINIMUM width has no semantic ancestor in tier 2 size, and without one a list of short labels renders as a sliver that is hard to aim at.

max-block-size.comment: A FALLBACK, used only when the positioning engine has not reported an available height - it cannot itself hold a var(--radix-...) reference. A var() referencing another var() is substituted at the element where it is DECLARED, and this token is declared at :root where no Radix variable exists, so routing it through here would collapse the whole declaration to `none` and let the listbox grow unbounded. That is BG-01M0WQY1 one tier down. The live value is read in the rule, where the popper has set it.
